jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Autonomous Defense
jobs.description_html:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

What You'll Do

We're looking for an AI Researcher to build the agents that turn our offensive knowledge into defensive action.

You'll build agents that reason from a proven attack path to the specific control changes that break it - EDR policy, firewall and segmentation rules, conditional access, detection content, cloud IAM, GPO - apply or stage those changes in the customer's environment, and then prove the fix by re-running the attack.

That last part is why this is tractable. Most defensive AI has no ground truth and gets graded on whether its advice sounds reasonable. Ours gets graded on whether the attack still works. You will have a real outcome signal on a short loop, and hundreds of thousands of prior tests to learn from. It is also why this is hard. These agents run inside customer tenants and modify production security controls. A bad change is an outage or a new hole in someone's defense. The reasoning problem and the safety problem are the same problem here, and you will own both.

The goal is closed-loop defense: find, fix, verify, running autonomously at enterprise scale. If you want to work on agents where the feedback is real and the stakes are real, this is the job for you.

Responsibilities

  • Build the reasoning systems that map proven attack paths and exploitation telemetry to specific, applicable control changes, ranked by effectiveness against operational blast radius.

  • Turn our pentest data into training and evaluation data. Extract the signal of why an attack succeeded in one environment and failed in another.

  • Design and run counterfactual experiments in representative test environments: would this change have broken this attack chain, what does it cost operationally, and does it generalize beyond the tenant it was learned in.

  • Design the reasoning layer over heterogeneous control planes so an agent can work across vendor APIs with different policy models without a hardcoded playbook per product.

  • Design the safety architecture for autonomous change — dry-run and simulation, blast-radius classification, approval gates for high-impact actions, staged rollout, rollback, and an audit trail a customer's change board will accept.

  • Work with our attack engineers and detection engineers to define target agent behavior and diagnose failure modes: ineffective remediations, over-broad changes, business-breaking policy edits, and recommendations that look right and don't hold on re-test.

  • Own problems end to end in a 0→1 environment where requirements are ambiguous, systems move fast, and reliability matters, because the output lands in someone's production security posture.

What You'll Bring

Required

  • Strong ML engineering experience building, evaluating, and deploying production AI systems, with hands-on work in deep learning, transformer models, and PyTorch.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: post-training large language models (supervised fine-tuning, distillation, preference optimization, RL), or designing agentic systems with tool use, planning, and long-horizon execution that hold up outside a demo.

  • A track record of building evaluation systems for open-ended tasks where there is no clean label and success is judged by outcome.

  • Experience reasoning over structured, heterogeneous, messy real-world data — configurations, graphs, logs, policy documents — rather than clean benchmark datasets.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of shipping and maintaining production-quality code in Python, not just scripts and proofs of concept.

  • Experience with data pipelines, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.

  • Ability to work across model behavior, APIs, and infrastructure, and to collaborate closely with attack engineers, detection engineers, product, and infrastructure.

  • Ability to independently research unfamiliar systems and rapidly become the team's expert.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including clear technical documentation.

  • Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, plus 4+ years of professional engineering experience.

You do not need to have been a pentester or a SOC analyst. You do need to be seriously interested in how attackers and defenders actually operate, and willing to learn it in depth. The reasoning we are building cannot be designed by someone who does not understand the domain.

Preferred

  • Background in detection engineering, purple teaming, security engineering, offensive security, or incident response.

  • Hands-on familiarity with security control planes and their APIs and policy models: EDR (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Defender), firewalls and segmentation (Palo Alto, Fortinet), identity and conditional access (Entra ID, Okta), SIEM and detection content (Splunk, Sentinel), cloud IAM, WAF, MDM, and GPO.

  • Experience with causal or counterfactual inference, or with graph reasoning, planning, and search over large state spaces. Familiarity with Neo4j and attack-path analysis.

  • Experience building automation that takes write actions in production systems, along with the safety and change-management machinery around it.

  • Experience with adversarial robustness or prompt injection, particularly where an agent consumes untrusted input from the environment it operates in.

  • Experience integrating ML into production, multi-tenant SaaS, or running ML systems in customer-controlled or air-gapped environments.

 

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $313,000 - $369,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

Collectively, we are a team of learn-it-alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

As a remote first company, we require minimum 25Mbps consumer grade broadband connection.

 

What You'll Do

The Principal Engineer for Database Platform is the technical anchor of NodeZero's data infrastructure. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports — your influence is through technical leadership, architecture ownership, and raising the engineering bar across the team. You own the most consequential database architecture decisions, define the standards that govern how NodeZero stores, queries, and migrates data at scale, and ensure the data layer can support NodeZero's growth — more customers, larger environments, more pentest data — without requiring proportional operational effort. This is a deeply hands-on role: you will write code, author design documents, and set the technical direction that every engineer on the Database Platform team builds toward.

NodeZero's data layer is not simple. We store millions of discovered assets, graph-structured attack paths, time-series vulnerability data, and audit-critical pentest results — across a multi-tenant architecture where correctness and data isolation are non-negotiable. You will be the person who makes the hardest data architecture calls and ensures the team has the technical foundations to build reliably on.

  • Technical Strategy: Define and drive the technical roadmap for the Database Platform in partnership with the Senior Engineering Manager and the broader Pentest Platform organization.

  • Architecture Leadership: Own the most complex database architecture decisions — schema design, partitioning strategies, migration patterns, and scalability approaches. Produce design documents that become the shared technical model for the team.

  • PostgreSQL Excellence: Be NodeZero's definitive expert on PostgreSQL at scale — query optimization, indexing, partitioning, replication, and connection pooling. Set the standards the team follows and catch the problems others miss.

  • Graph & Multi-model Data: Architect and guide the evolution of NodeZero's graph-based asset model — the data structure that represents how discovered hosts, services, credentials, and vulnerabilities relate to each other across pentests.

  • Schema Governance: Own schema design review processes. Ensure every migration is safe, reversible, and zero-downtime. Build the tooling and culture that treats schema changes with the same rigor as production code changes.

  • Mentorship & Bar Raising: Mentor P5 and P4 engineers through code review, design review, and pairing. Be the person on the team that raises everyone else's ceiling.

  • Cross-functional Influence: Partner with Data Ingestion, Asset Inventory, API Platform, and Security Research to define data contracts, query performance standards, and architectural guardrails that span the full data pipeline.

 

What You'll Bring

Technical Depth

  • Deep, production-proven PostgreSQL expertise: query planner internals, advanced indexing (partial, expression, GiST/GIN), partitioning strategies, logical replication, vacuuming at scale, and connection pool tuning.

  • Experience architecting multi-tenant databases at scale: row-level security, tenant isolation, schema-per-tenant vs. shared-schema tradeoffs.

  • Experience with schema migration at scale in production systems: zero-downtime migrations, backwards-compatible schema evolution, and migration tooling (Flyway, golang-migrate, or equivalent).

  • Familiarity with graph data models and graph databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune) or graph-like query patterns in relational systems (recursive CTEs, ltree, adjacency list).

  • Proficient in Go or Python — able to write production application code, not just SQL.

Architecture & Design

  • Demonstrated track record of defining database architecture at scale — from design doc to production — across multiple companies or teams.

  • Strong opinions on data architecture tradeoffs: normalization vs. denormalization, consistency vs. availability, OLTP vs. OLAP workload separation, and schema-first vs. schema-last design.

  • Able to reason about long-horizon schema design: what does this schema look like in two years, at 10× the current data volume, with three new feature teams writing to it?

  • Able to communicate complex database decisions clearly in writing — for design docs, ADRs, and cross-team reviews — so engineers without deep DB expertise can understand and apply the reasoning.

Leadership Without Authority

  • Proven ability to drive database standards across multiple teams without direct reporting authority — including teams that are not the Database Platform team.

  • Experience establishing database engineering culture: schema review norms, migration safety standards, and query performance review processes.

  • Track record of growing engineers through code review, pair programming, and architectural mentorship — especially engineers who are strong in application code but earlier in their database expertise.

 

Nice to Haves

  • Background in cybersecurity data: vulnerability databases, network scan schemas, or attack surface management data models.

  • Experience with time-series databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB) in addition to relational.

  • Familiarity with data platform compliance requirements: SOC 2 Type II, FedRAMP data handling, or GDPR/CCPA.

  • Experience with analytical query patterns or BI/reporting workloads on operational data.

  • Contributions to open-source database tooling or PostgreSQL ecosystem projects.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Autonomous Defense team, you'll be the person who gets our defensive models into production and keeps them there. Our AI researchers define how NodeZero's agents should reason. You build the pipelines, serve infrastructure, and release machinery that turns that research into something running against thousands of customer tenants every day.

This is the seam where most AI products fail. A model that performs well in a notebook is not a capability. It becomes one when there is a reproducible training pipeline, an evaluation suite that runs in CI, a versioned release path with canaries and rollback, monitoring that catches regressions before customers do, and a cost and latency profile the business can afford. That is your work.

You'll work directly with our AI researchers and closely with backend and infrastructure engineers. You are not being hired to do research, and you are not being hired to do generic platform work. You own the path from model to production.

Responsibilities

  • Build and own the training and post-training pipelines — data preparation, fine-tuning and preference optimization runs, experiment tracking, artifact management, and reproducibility.

  • Build the inference and serving layer: model gateway with provider routing and fallback, regional pinning for data residency, batching, and caching.

  • Own the release path for model-layer artifacts: version prompts, model selections, and tool definitions as deployable config; run shadow and canary deployments by tenant; make rollback fast and boring.

  • Build monitoring for the model layer — behavioral drift, regression detection, output quality signals, latency, and per-tenant token and cost accounting with budget enforcement.

  • Build the data and context pipelines that feed inference, including retrieval and embedding infrastructure over attack path, configuration, and remediation data, with tenant isolation enforced end to end.

  • Optimize cost and latency across the inference path, and make the tradeoffs visible so product decisions are made with real numbers.

  • Develop core product features in ETL and GraphQL where model outputs, run history, and evaluation results need to reach the product and internal tooling.

  • Partner with researchers to move prototypes into production, and feed production constraints and failure data back into research direction.

Required Education / Experience

  • 5+ yrs professional software engineering experience, with strong production Python.

  • Demonstrated experience taking ML or LLM-backed systems from prototype to production and operating them.

  • Hands-on experience with ML pipelines and tooling: training or fine-tuning workflows, experiment tracking, artifact and model registries, and reproducible data preparation.

  • Experience building and operating inference or model-serving infrastructure in production, including latency and cost optimization.

  • Experience building applications on cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, using container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Solid proficiency in SQL and experience with production data pipelines.

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience operationalizing LLM or agentic systems specifically.

  • Hands-on post-training experience: supervised fine-tuning, distillation, preference optimization, or RL, including the infrastructure around the runs.

  • Experience with model gateways or multi-provider routing, and with self-hosted or customer-hosted inference (vLLM, TGI, Bedrock, or similar).

  • Experience with GPU infrastructure, quantization, or inference optimization.

  • Experience with database architectures including relational (PostgreSQL) and graph (Neo4j), and with GraphQL backends.

  • Experience with observability tooling (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana) and distributed tracing, including tracing across model calls.

  • Experience shipping ML into regulated, air-gapped, or customer-controlled environments, or under compliance regimes like FedRAMP.

The Role

We are looking for a GTM & Technical Recruiter, Federal to help build the talent engine for Horizon3’s Federal business. You will partner closely with leaders across Federal, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and People to define hiring needs, build targeted talent strategies, and attract, assess, and close outstanding candidates. Your work will span the Department of Defense, military services, defense agencies, and adjacent Federal organizations, with particular focus on candidates who possess specialized experience and security clearances.

The ideal candidate brings strong recruiting fundamentals, enough technical fluency to earn credibility with cybersecurity and engineering talent, and deep familiarity with the Federal talent ecosystem. You will apply the same high talent bar we hold across Horizon3 recruiting, adapted thoughtfully to the Federal world, while helping the company compete for candidates in a complex, relationship-driven market.

What You’ll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for Federal GTM and technical roles, from intake and sourcing through assessment, offer, and close.

  • Partner with hiring managers and leadership to translate business priorities into clear role profiles, interview plans, sourcing strategies, and hiring plans.

  • Build and maintain high-quality, diverse pipelines across Federal sales, account management, capture and business development, solutions engineering, customer success, cybersecurity, engineering, product, marketing and related roles.

  • Develop a strong network across the Federal ecosystem, including the Department of Defense, military services, defense agencies, systems integrators, contractors, cybersecurity companies, and mission-focused technology organizations.

  • Recruit candidates with active, recent, or relevant special clearances and experience navigating clearance-sensitive hiring environments; understand clearance eligibility, adjudication timelines, and role-specific constraints without overpromising outcomes.

  • Create repeatable sourcing strategies for difficult-to-reach talent, including passive candidates, cleared professionals, veterans, military-to-industry talent, and high-performing candidates from adjacent markets.

  • Conduct structured screens that assess role-relevant capability, judgment, motivation, communication, and alignment with Horizon3’s talent bar.

  • Build credible relationships with candidates across both GTM and technical disciplines, including the ability to engage in informed conversations about cybersecurity, cloud, software, Federal missions, and commercial growth.

  • Partner with interview teams to maintain rigorous, consistent, and equitable assessment processes and to make timely, well-calibrated decisions.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to hiring managers: provide market insight, create clarity, challenge assumptions, and push back when a search strategy or assessment process is not likely to produce the right outcome.

  • Manage complex offer processes and close candidates thoughtfully, including compensation alignment, leveling, competing offers, mission fit, remote-work considerations, and clearance-related timing.

  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience while maintaining appropriate discretion around clearance status and other sensitive candidate information.

  • Use recruiting data to identify bottlenecks, improve funnel health, measure pipeline quality, and increase recruiting efficiency.

  • Help establish scalable Federal recruiting infrastructure, including talent maps, evergreen pipelines, market intelligence, referral strategies, and operating rhythms with business and People leaders.

  • Continuously evaluate and improve recruiting processes that are no longer serving the business, bringing creativity and practical experimentation to how Horizon3 hires.

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience as a full-cycle recruiter supporting both go-to-market and technical hiring, ideally in cybersecurity, defense technology, national security, government contracting, or a related high-growth environment.

  • Demonstrated success recruiting across the Defense Technology Ecosystem, with an established network and practical understanding of how cleared and clearance-eligible talent evaluates opportunities.

  • Experience hiring for some combination of Federal sales, business development, capture, solutions engineering, customer success, cybersecurity, engineering, product, or other specialized technical roles.

  • Working knowledge of security-clearance recruiting, including clearance terminology, transferability considerations, adjudication timelines, and the importance of careful, accurate candidate communication.

  • Strong technical acumen and the ability to learn new technical domains quickly enough to assess talent and have credible conversations with engineers, cybersecurity practitioners, and technical customer-facing candidates.

  • Strong negotiation and closing skills, with a track record of earning trust and closing candidates in competitive markets.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence candidates, hiring managers, executives, and cross-functional partners.

  • High social aptitude and relationship-building ability—you build trust quickly and maintain long-term candidate and stakeholder relationships.

  • Experience operating with a high talent bar and applying structured, evidence-based judgment across different candidate backgrounds and career paths.

  • Ability to balance speed and quality, especially when business urgency, scarce talent, and clearance timelines create competing pressures.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently, prioritize effectively, and drive processes forward in an evolving environment.

  • Data-driven mindset with a focus on improving recruiting outcomes, efficiency, consistency, and candidate experience.

  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience recruiting for a Federal startup, defense technology company, cybersecurity company, government contractor, or systems integrator.

  • Existing relationships with cleared talent communities, veteran and military-transition networks, Federal professional associations, or defense and national-security technology communities.

  • Experience recruiting candidates with TS/SCI, SCI, polygraph, or other specialized clearances, where relevant to the role.

  • Familiarity with mission areas and the broader defense technology landscape.

  • Experience building a recruiting function, market map, evergreen pipeline, or repeatable sourcing program from the ground up.

  • Coursework or degree in business, human resources, psychology, information technology, or a related field.

Travel and Work Environment

About the Role

This role requires a strong blend of product leadership, cybersecurity expertise, threat intelligence experience, technical depth, and customer empathy to help organizations quickly understand whether emerging vulnerabilities create real, exploitable risk in their environments.

The Staff Product Manager for Rapid Response will own the product strategy, roadmap, customer experience, and operating model for NodeZero Rapid Response. This leader will partner closely with the Attack Team, Engineering, Data, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Channel, and Support to define how Horizon3 monitors emerging threats, determines which vulnerabilities matter, maps those threats to customer environments, validates real-world exploitability, and helps customers take action before attackers do.

Responsibilities

Rapid Response Product Strategy & Leadership

  • Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for NodeZero Rapid Response, helping customers understand and respond to emerging vulnerabilities based on real exploitability and customer-specific risk.

  • Establish the end-to-end operating model for Rapid Response, from initial threat signal through research, prioritization, customer relevance analysis, exploit/test development, notification, remediation, retesting, and verification.

  • Set clear ownership, decision rights, service-level expectations, and operating rhythms across the teams required to deliver Rapid Response at speed.

  • Drive standardization and scalability across Rapid Response research, customer communications, integrations, and operational workflows.

Exploit Intelligence & Coverage Strategy

  • Establish and grow exploit-intelligence relationships with security vendors, researchers, and other relevant intelligence providers to identify emerging Rapid Response opportunities as early as possible.

  • Define the threat intelligence strategy for Rapid Response across vendor advisories, CVEs, CISA KEV, public research, exploit repositories, attacker activity, and other sources of vulnerability and exploit intelligence.

  • Develop a prioritization framework for determining which vulnerabilities warrant immediate Rapid Response coverage based on exploitability, attacker utility, prevalence, customer footprint, potential impact, and evidence of exploitation in the wild.

  • Partner directly with vulnerability researchers and attack engineers to assess exploit prerequisites, affected products and versions, attack techniques, mitigations, and the evidence and production-safety controls needed to validate exploitability in customer environments.

Customer Relevance, Exploitability & Automation

  • Build capabilities that identify which customers, environments, and assets are potentially affected by an emerging threat using asset intelligence, technology fingerprinting, exposure context, historical NodeZero data, and other relevant signals.

  • Drive the product, onboarding, and Customer Success motion required to get 100% of customers to run EAD and keep discovery current so Rapid Response notifications can be relevant and actionable.

  • Drive automation that accelerates exploit and test development, including reusable research and exploit-development workflows, AI-assisted analysis, automated data collection, quality gates, and production-safety checks.

  • Define and monitor operational metrics such as time from disclosure to threat assessment, time to customer relevance determination, time to test availability, alert precision, validation coverage, remediation rates, and retest rates.

Customer Adoption, Growth & Go-to-Market

  • Track Rapid Response test rates by event, customer, segment, and technology to ensure the offering is delivering measurable customer value and to identify adoption gaps that require product or go-to-market action.

  • Own Rapid Response attach-rate analysis and define customer-level triggers for renewals, new ARR, and expansion when an event is relevant to a customer's technology stack, industry, or exposure profile.

  • Partner with Alliances, Channel, and Marketing to turn Rapid Response intelligence and event content into partner plays, enablement, packaging, and campaigns that accelerate attach rates and qualified demand.

  • Define the measurement funnel from threat event to awareness, customer notification, test execution, remediation, pipeline influence, retention, and expansion, and use those insights to improve the product and go-to-market motion.

Cross-Functional Execution, UX & Reporting

  • Own the quality of the Rapid Response user experience and reporting, ensuring customers can quickly understand whether they are affected, see proof, take action, communicate results internally, and confidently demonstrate the value of the product.

  • Define how Rapid Response fits into customer security operations through notifications, APIs, ticketing, SIEM/SOAR, vulnerability management, and other security and IT workflows.

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Channel, and Support to drive launches, enablement, customer education, adoption, event response, and feedback loops for Rapid Response.

  • Engage directly with CISOs, vulnerability management teams, SOC teams, incident responders, security researchers, prospects, and partners to understand emerging-threat response workflows and unmet needs.

Travel Required

  • Hybrid role is located in San Francisco, New York, or Washington DC. Role may require up to 20% travel to be successful.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience building deeply technical B2B SaaS products, with significant cybersecurity experience and depth in one or more domains such as vulnerability management, exposure management, offensive security, incident response, SOC operations, attack surface management, endpoint security, or threat detection and response.

  • Threat intelligence experience is required. You have hands-on experience working in or closely with cyber threat intelligence, vulnerability intelligence, threat research, emerging-threat response, or a closely related discipline.

  • Strong technical understanding of the vulnerability and exploitation lifecycle—including CVEs, CISA KEV, vendor advisories, proof-of-concept exploits, exploitation in the wild, affected products and versions, exploit prerequisites, mitigations, and remediation—with enough depth to work directly with vulnerability researchers and attack engineers on safe exploitability validation.

  • Experience translating threat intelligence into actionable customer outcomes rather than simply presenting feeds, scores, or lists of vulnerabilities.

  • Experience building products that combine multiple sources of telemetry, intelligence, and customer context to make high-confidence decisions.

  • Strong product judgment and the ability to make decisions quickly when information is incomplete, the threat landscape is changing rapidly, and emerging vulnerabilities require response outside normal business hours.

  • Proven ability to work closely with engineers, designers, researchers, and security practitioners to translate complex technical capabilities into scalable product experiences.

  • Strong communication, stakeholder-management, and data-driven decision-making skills, with experience using customer feedback, threat data, product analytics, and operational metrics to prioritize investments and communicate clearly with customers, executives, and go-to-market teams.

 

Perks of Horizon3

We are seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to join a team developing AI applications that help users understand and act on complex Naval engineering records. Using a Forward Deployed Engineering model, our team works closely with mission users to understand how they work, identify friction in their daily tasks, and deliver functional improvements based on rapid feedback.

Staff Platform Engineer

Defense Unicorns is seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to join our team. This role is responsible for designing, building, and owning the runtime production environment that bridges applications (custom development, COTS, and OSS) to the underlying platform. You will drive platform architecture decisions, set engineering standards, and serve as the technical anchor between application teams and platform teams.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will own platform strategy and implementation end-to-end: defining technical roadmaps, solving complex problems that span multiple domains, driving cross-team delivery efficiency, and mentoring engineers across the team. We are looking for someone who builds and owns platforms, not someone who operates within infrastructure others have designed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain scalable runtime production environments across cloud-native and containerized systems, including transforming applications into Kubernetes-friendly formats for bare-metal deployment
  • Own the technical roadmap for the platform vertical, identifying gaps, planning initiatives, and aligning engineering effort to mission objectives
  • Provide mentorship to engineers across the team, fostering professional development and raising the technical bar
  • Identify technical overlap across projects and guide teams on leveraging each other for efficient delivery
  • Work closely with Mission Managers, providing insights on engineering competency, capacity, velocity, and alignment with mission objectives

Senior Platform Engineer

AI Engineering | Forward Deployed Engineering

Role Description

Defense Unicorns is seeking a senior AI Agentic Engineer to embed with a government team and its technology partners building an emerging AI-powered engineering ecosystem.

This role will focus on designing, integrating, and operationalizing AI agents and agentic workflows within a secure enterprise environment. The engineer will work across large language models, agent frameworks, enterprise data, APIs, developer tooling, and platform services to turn AI capabilities into reliable, mission-relevant workflows.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who understands both the capabilities and limitations of modern AI systems and can rapidly translate emerging technologies into working solutions. They should be comfortable experimenting with new models and agent frameworks, integrating agents with enterprise systems and tools, evaluating performance and reliability, and working alongside platform engineers and commercial technology partners.

This is not a research-only role. The focus is on moving from AI concepts and prototypes to secure, useful, repeatable agentic capabilities that can operate in production environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and integrate AI agents and multi-agent workflows using modern LLM and agentic technologies.
  • Develop agent capabilities that interact with enterprise applications, APIs, data sources, developer tools, and mission systems.
  • Integrate models, agents, tools, and enterprise data into secure workflows that can be deployed in controlled and classified environments.
  • Work with LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, tool/function calling, structured outputs, MCP, and related technologies.
  • Develop mechanisms for agents to securely discover, access, reason over, and act upon approved enterprise data and services.
  • Prototype and rapidly evaluate emerging models, agent frameworks, and AI capabilities to determine where they can create measurable mission or engineering value.
  • Develop evaluation and testing frameworks for agent accuracy, reliability, safety, latency, cost, and task completion.
  • Implement guardrails and policy controls governing agent behavior, tool access, data access, and human approval points.
  • Integrate agentic capabilities with CI/CD and DevSecOps workflows to support repeatable development, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management.
  • Collaborate with platform engineers to operationalize AI workloads within Kubernetes/OpenShift environments.

  • Develop reusable patterns for agent deployment, configuration, observability, evaluation, and lifecycle management.
  • Document architectures, integration patterns, agent specifications, evaluation results, and operational procedures.
  • Identify recurring AI engineering challenges that can be standardized, automated, or productized into reusable capabilities.
  • Stay current with rapidly evolving agentic AI technologies and assess their applicability to secure government environments.

  • Experience with Red Hat OpenShift AI or Kubernetes-based AI platforms.
  • Experience with agent evaluation and observability frameworks.
  • Experience implementing AI guardrails, policy enforcement, human-in-the-loop workflows, or AI safety controls.
  • Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or comparable frameworks.
  • Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and enterprise search.
  • Experience deploying AI systems in Secret or TS/SCI environments.
  • Experience with disconnected or air-gapped AI environments.
  • Experience integrating AI into developer/DevSecOps workflows.
  • Familiarity with GitLab, Jira, Confluence, Xacta, or similar enterprise engineering and compliance tools.

jobs.title: Radar Product Manager
jobs.description_html:
Why LeoLabs? 

At LeoLabs, we’re building the living map of activity in space. Through our proprietary global radar network and AI-enabled analytics platform, we collect millions of measurements each day on more than 25,000 objects in low Earth orbit (LEO). Our radar-powered intelligence helps protect critical assets, characterize activity in orbit, monitor emerging threats, and enable safer and more effective operations for commercial and government missions. 

We’re not just building technology—we are redefining global security, safety, and transparency in space. As orbital activity accelerates and the operating environment becomes increasingly complex, LeoLabs is a trusted partner for Space Domain Awareness, Space Traffic Management, satellite operations, and national security missions around the world. 

If you're looking to work on mission-critical challenges at the intersection of aerospace, national security, sensing, software, data, and AI, your impact starts here. This position is contingent upon final approval, with an anticipated hiring timeline beginning as early as January 2027. We are beginning the search in advance of the anticipated hiring timeline. 

LeoLabs is seeking a Radar Product Manager to lead the continued development, commercialization, and growth of our transportable radar product, our radar-based space domain awareness product. 

Our transportable radar product combines advanced radar sensing, software, data processing, and operational capabilities to provide customers with persistent, high-quality information about objects and activity in low Earth orbit. Our transportable radar product extends LeoLabs' ability to deploy sensing capability where customers need it and enables a range of commercial and government missions. 

This role sits at the intersection of customers, product strategy, radar technology, engineering, operations, deployment, and business objectives. You will be responsible for understanding customer missions and market opportunities, defining where our transportable radar product should compete, shaping the capabilities and configurations customers need, and helping turn advanced radar technology into scalable products and services customers can buy, deploy, and operate. 

The ideal candidate is a strong product thinker with both commercial and technical judgment. You should have experience working in the space industry or in a closely related aerospace or national-security environment, be comfortable working with complex hardware and software systems, and be able to translate customer missions and technical capabilities into clear product and business direction. 

What You’ll Do 

  • Own the product and business strategy for our transportable radar product, including product vision, roadmap, market positioning, prioritization, packaging, configurations, and execution
  • Develop a deep understanding of our transportable radar product customers, users, missions, workflows, operational environments, procurement considerations, and buying behavior
  • Work directly with commercial and government customers, operators, mission partners, internal stakeholders, and subject-matter experts to identify unmet needs, validate product opportunities, and determine where our transportable radar product can create differentiated value
  • Identify and prioritize market segments, mission areas, use cases, deployment models, and customer problems where our transportable radar product can create meaningful mission impact and business growth
  • Translate customer, mission, and business requirements into clear product requirements, system capabilities, configurations, interfaces, and prioritized development work
  • Partner closely with radar, hardware, software, systems, data, infrastructure, and operations teams throughout the product lifecycle, from discovery and definition through development, integration, testing, deployment, operation, and iteration
  • Make product investment decisions based on customer value, strategic differentiation, revenue potential, sensor performance, technical feasibility, operational complexity, scalability, and company priorities
  • Define how our transportable radar product capabilities, configurations, service levels, and access models are packaged and positioned so customers can clearly understand what they are buying, what mission outcomes it enables, and how it differs from other LeoLabs offerings

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer (United Kingdom)
jobs.location: United Kingdom, London and Surrounding Areas
jobs.description_html:
Second Front Systems (2F) is seeking an ambitious and capable Platform Engineer to join our UK team. We are a dynamic, fast-growing defence technology company at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and national security, committed to delivering transformative solutions that empower the UK’s defenders. This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in establishing and scaling our platform capability in the UK market.

At 2F we thrive on innovation and purpose, combining a start-up’s agility with a clear mission to support national security. You will be at the forefront of the DevSecOps engineering behind the deployment and scaling of our Game Warden platform — accelerating the secure adoption of mission-critical SaaS solutions for UK government and defence. If you value ingenuity, collaboration, and impact, we want to hear from you.

Security Clearance Requirement: This position requires the holder to hold, or be eligible to obtain, Developed Vetting (DV) clearance. Candidates must be UK nationals (or hold dual nationality with the UK as one nationality) and have sufficient UK residency history to be sponsored for DV. Active DV clearance is strongly preferred. As this role involves work within classified and air-gapped environments, clearance eligibility is essential and non-negotiable.

Location: Primarily remote (UK-based), with frequent travel to customer and partner sites, including Northwood and Corsham Defence Campus, and occasional travel to other UK government locations. Candidates must be based within the UK and willing to travel as operational demand requires. Note that work in air-gapped or classified environments will require on-site presence at accredited facilities.

What You'll Do

  • Support the security and operations of Game Warden across air-gapped and classified environments, working directly with government partners and security teams.

  • Build and manage CI/CD pipelines that integrate DevSecOps best practices from development through to deployment.

  • Integrate and maintain SIEM and security tooling, ensuring observability and compliance across all deployed systems.

  • Build and implement scalable, secure cloud infrastructure using Kubernetes and Pulumi (Go-based), ensuring compliance with UK government and Ministry of Defence security requirements.

  • Work cross-functionally to assess infrastructure needs, prioritise development, and deliver on product roadmap milestones in a fast-paced Agile environment.

  • Document your work thoroughly — from infrastructure to internal procedures — to ensure secure, repeatable, and auditable deployments.

  • Collaborate directly with UK defence and government stakeholders to provision secure cloud resources and meet deployment and accreditation criteria in classified settings.

  • Contribute to R&D and experimentation needed to advance platform capabilities in secure and disconnected environments.

  • Act as a senior technical resource, helping to shape 2F’s UK DevSecOps strategy and infrastructure standards.

What You Bring

  • 5–7+ years of relevant experience in DevSecOps, systems engineering, and software development.

  • Senior-level expertise designing and building cloud-native platforms using AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native application orchestration.

  • Strong proficiency in Golang or similar languages

  • Familiarity with UK and international compliance frameworks such as MOD Secure by Design, JSP 453, NCSC Cloud Security Principles, NIST 800-53.

  • Experience deploying systems in air-gapped or classified environments.

  • Experience building and maintaining secure CI/CD pipelines and integrating security throughout the SDLC.

  • Hands-on experience implementing or managing SIEM, monitoring, and alerting systems.

  • Understanding of REST APIs, authentication flows, event-driven architecture, and microservice patterns.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong documentation habits.

  • Comfortable working independently and in distributed teams, managing competing priorities across complex projects.

  • Proficient in using AI tools (such as Claude and Gemini) to accelerate and enhance day-to-day work, from code generation, debugging, and documentation to research and problem-solving — with sound judgement about where AI adds value and where human oversight is required.

  • Certified AWS, Google or Azure Solutions Architect.

  • Prior experience working within UK defence, national security, or regulated government environments.

  • Experience working in early-stage or high-growth start-up environments.

  • Familiarity with UK accreditation and risk-management processes and environments (e.g., MOD Secure by Design).

  • Familiarity with GitLab, Google Workspace, and Slack.

  • A genuine interest in national security and mission-driven innovation.

 

The base salary for this position will fall between £110,00000 - £130,000 Your ultimate compensation will be determined by professional background, technical proficiency, seniority, and regional cost factors. Furthermore, this opportunity includes potential eligibility for equity awards and discretionary bonuses, rounding out a comprehensive total rewards offering.

 

Success at 2F Looks Like:

  • Viewing obstacles as opportunities for growth

  • Having a bias toward action and tangible, measurable results

  • Striving to be both compassionate and direct with your feedback

  • Being team-oriented and inclusive with your actions

Perks & Benefits:

As a public benefit company, we are a team of purpose-driven trailblazers transforming the future of national security. We hire the best to do their best and are committed to providing the perks and benefits you need to be successful, both inside and outside the workplace.

  • Competitive salary benchmarked to UK market

  • Private healthcare (medical, dental, and optical)

  • Pension scheme with employer contribution

  • Wellness perks (fitness, mental health resources)

  • Equity incentive plan

  • Technology and home-office stipend

  • Annual professional development budget

  • Flexible paid time off plus UK public holidays

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Remote-first working with travel expenses covered

  • Referral bonus scheme

Visit our careers page to learn more.

UK Employment Information

Second Front Systems is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership status, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation, in accordance with the Equality Act 2010.

Applicants have the right to work in the United Kingdom. Due to the DV clearance requirement, candidates must be UK nationals or hold qualifying dual nationality and must have resided primarily in the UK for the period required by UKSV vetting guidelines. Sponsorship for this role is not available.

This role is a full-time permanent position. Salary will be discussed during the recruitment process. We are happy to discuss reasonable adjustments at any stage of the application process for candidates with a disability or long-term health condition.

Who We Are:

At Second Front Systems (2F), we equip defence and national security professionals with access to emerging technologies. Founded with firsthand experience of the dangers that outdated technology poses in operational environments, our team is dedicated to fast-tracking government access to disruptive, commercially-proven technology for national security missions.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Mission Agents
jobs.description_html:
Vannevar builds AI systems for the Department of War's most consequential missions. We have 125 deployments across every branch and combatant command spanning our core platform and five distinct products. An an example of how we work, when major combat operations started with Iran, we fielded a new product supporting 24/7 operations and 9,000+ users in three months.

How we build is our advantage: we deploy forward with the people who own the mission. Our engineers, product team, and CTO deploy forward to the point of friction, including visiting units in Ukraine. We focus on embedding directly with operational units supporting great power competition with China, combat operations with Iran, and counter-narcotics missions.

About the role

We’re hiring a Product Manager for our Mission Agents team.

This team owns the systems that turn user intent into execution - from chat and tasking to persistent agent workflows. You will define how users delegate work to software, how those systems operate on real-world data, and how they are monitored, constrained, and improved over time.

This is not a traditional roadmap role. You will take in incomplete, conflicting inputs from users, stakeholders, data, and systems - and decide what we should actually build.

You will work closely with operators, forward deployed engineers, and engineering teams to identify high-leverage problems and drive them through to shipped capability. You will often need to ignore loud or conflicting inputs and make decisions that others disagree with.

This role reports to the CTO and operates at the intersection of mission, product, and engineering. Success is measured by whether we build the right things and those things create real mission impact.

What you'll do

  • Synthesize signal into direction. Take in messy, conflicting inputs and determine what actually matters.
  • Define how agents behave. Shape primitives like objectives, constraints, trust tiers, and evaluation criteria.
  • Improve output quality. Drive systematic improvements across models, memory, and workflows.
  • Own product direction end-to-end. Turn ambiguous problems into concrete bets and drive them through delivery.
  • Work directly with users. Build deep intuition for real-world workflows and needs.
  • Translate mission signal into product direction. Take in real-world user signal and translate it into clear product direction, including pushing back when needed.
  • Partner with engineering. Shape solutions that are both impactful and technically sound.
  • Drive alignment in ambiguous situations. Bring clarity across stakeholders when perspectives conflict.

What you should have

  • Strong product judgment. You consistently identify the right problems and make sound prioritization decisions.
  • Ability to separate signal from noise. You form independent, defensible opinions from incomplete and conflicting inputs.
  • Experience with complex systems or platforms. You’ve worked on products where behavior emerges from underlying primitives.
  • Experience operating under real constraints. You’ve shipped products where security, infrastructure, or deployment realities shaped decisions.
  • High ownership and bias toward action. You take responsibility for outcomes and push work through to completion.
  • Technical fluency. You can engage with engineers and understand system constraints and tradeoffs.
  • Clear, direct communication. You can articulate decisions, tradeoffs, and reasoning in a way others can act on.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with operational or mission-driven users
  • Experience with LLM-based systems
  • Experience with product analytics (e.g., SQL)
  • Experience rapidly prototyping ideas (Figma, AI coding tools, etc.)
  • Exposure to constrained or high-security environments
  • Active Security clearance (or ability to obtain one) and willingness to travel onsite

What we offer

We’re proud to offer competitive benefits that support our employees. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 100% remote first culture. You can work from anywhere in the US and all full time employees have WeWork access

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.description_html:
About Us

AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.

The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.

AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.

The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.

Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.

Software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Come build that future with us.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

We are seeking a highly motivated and versatile Director of Product Design to join our startup, building products at the intersection of cyber-security and software development to disrupt the large Application Security market. The ideal candidate will have full-stack experience spanning user research, interaction design, and visual design. They will have demonstrable results delivering delightful security and developer experiences via a SaaS service.

  • Own the design of core user journeys across the product, from initial flows to polished UI
  • Collaborate with engineering and product to implement new features and refine existing ones
  • Bring clarity to complex user experiences as our product elves and scales
  • Create and maintain a clean, modern visual language inspired
  • Work closely with our Head of Design to articulate and evolve Endor design principles
  • Ensuring that users know what to do without needing to be told

What You Bring to the Table

If you are interested in helping to define, build, and grow the product at an early-stage company, and the list below matches your background, we would love to talk to you!

  • Strong portfolio that demonstrates both visual polish and UX depth.
  • Passion for building products that are intuitive, beautiful and a joy to use
  • 4-8+ years experience as a Product Designer in a similar role.
  • Experience working closely with engineers and understanding implementation constraints
  • Proven ability to operate autonomously
  • Self-starter: You can take ownership of an area and deliver beyond expectations.
  • Take pride in your craft: You set a high bar for yourself and those around you; you’re meticulous about the details without losing sight of the big picture

Bonus: Experience building developer-centric and/or cybersecurity centric product experiences. Experience in designing self-service workflows for rapid product adoption, and product-led growth strategy.

 

Why Endor Labs

We’re building at the intersection of developer productivity and security — one of the fastest-growing spaces in software. Our dev-loved platform has real ROI, strong momentum, and customers who care about doing things right.

At Endor Labs, we think big, start small, and learn fast. We take ownership, move with purpose, and always start with the customer’s success. We debate with data, make the complex simple, and challenge each other with kindness and candor. We celebrate wins, learn from misses, and have fun along the way — because when our customers win, we all win.

 

Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if you don't fit every requirement above, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and experiences, so we encourage all talented individuals to apply—there's no one-size-fits-all here.

Compensation: For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the base salary is expected to be between $140,000 - $200,000. This may include incentives/variable compensations such as commissions, stock options and/or bonuses, depending on the position. Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements.

  • Serve as the principal manager and strategic owner of Okta’s global health and safety vendor ecosystem, including multinational EHS environmental/safety consulting firms, localized safety practitioners, and specialized service partners.
  • Develop Statements of Work (SOWs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and service level agreements (SLAs) for external EHS partners supporting regional risk assessments, statutory testing, and compliance filings.
  • Manage vendor procurement, contract evaluations, invoicing, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) to ensure cost-efficiency, technical rigor, and consistent service delivery across all global locations.
  • Direct external partners in conducting localized site inspections, air quality monitoring, industrial hygiene assessments, and acoustic/lighting studies.

2. Global Workers' Compensation & Claims Management

  • Serve as the single point of contact and global program manager for Okta’s Workers’ Compensation, Employers' Liability, and occupational injury/illness programs across all global jurisdictions.
  • Collaborate closely with People Operations (HR), Risk Management/Treasury, legal counsel, insurance brokers, and Third-Party Claims Administrators (TPAs) to oversee claim lifecycles, reserve tracking, and settlements.
  • Implement and manage a global Return-to-Work (RTW) and modified-duty framework to support injured or ill employees and safely reduce lost time.
  • Conduct regular claims audits, review carrier loss-run reports, identify global workplace injury trends, and execute root-cause mitigation programs.
  • Ensure regulatory reporting compliance across regions (e.g., Irish Health and Safety Authority [HSA] statutory notifications, US OSHA 300 logs, and relevant EMEA/APAC incident reporting requirements).

3. Global Health & Safety Governance & Statutory Compliance

  • Formulate, maintain, and enforce Okta’s global Health & Safety standard operating procedures (SOPs), workplace safety manuals, and corporate safety policies across all regional hubs.
  • Monitor multi-jurisdictional compliance across all regions (e.g., Irish Safety, Health and Welfare at Work Act, EU Workplace Directives, UK HSE regulations, US OSHA standards, and APAC regional health codes), leveraging specialized regional legal and consulting partners where necessary.
  • Oversee site-level risk assessments (General Risk Assessments, Fire Risk Assessments, Display Screen Equipment/DSE assessments) and track all corrective actions to closure.
  • Act as Okta’s primary liaison for statutory safety authorities, labor inspectorates, municipal fire services, and external compliance auditors worldwide.

4. Global Ergonomics & Preventive Wellness

  • Direct Okta’s Global Ergonomics Program across both physical corporate offices and our distributed, remote-first workforce.
  • Partner with external ergonomic evaluation platforms, specialized ergonomic physical therapists/evaluators, and internal workplace experience teams to review complex cases and reasonable accommodation requests.
  • Oversee the ergonomic evaluation workflow, self-assessment software adoption, and equipment reimbursement guidelines in alignment with corporate policy and regional procurement structures.

5. Emergency Preparedness, GSOC Coordination & Safety Culture

  • Lead incident investigation workflows for global safety incidents, significant near-misses, and occupational health concerns; determine root causes and institute corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Partner with Okta's Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), Physical Security, and Workplace Experience teams to ensure rapid incident escalation and crisis coordination.
  • Standardize life safety programs globally, including local Emergency Wardens, First Aiders, evacuation drills, automated external defibrillator (AED) maintenance, and emergency supply readiness.
  • Define, track, and report on global safety metrics (such as Lost Time Injury Frequency Rates [LTIFR], Total Recordable Incident Rates [TRIR], ergonomics SLA closures, and vendor performance).

 

Qualifications & Experience

Required:

  • Experience: 6+ years of progressive professional experience leading environmental health, safety, and occupational wellness programs within multinational enterprise or fast-paced technology environments.
  • Global Scope: Demonstrated experience managing health and safety programs across multi-site global portfolios spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC.
  • Vendor & Partner Management: Proven track record of managing global EHS third-party vendors, specialized consulting firms, and outsourced safety service providers to scale global coverage.
  • Workers' Compensation & Claims: Strong, direct experience managing global or multi-regional workers' compensation programs, employer liability claims, TPAs, and structured Return-to-Work (RTW) processes.
  • Regulatory Acumen: Solid understanding of Irish Health and Safety Authority (HSA) statutory requirements and EU Health & Safety Directives, paired with the capability to oversee international compliance frameworks (e.g., US OSHA).
  • Certifications & Education:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Risk Management, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Recognized professional health and safety certification (e.g., NEBOSH Diploma/Certificate, GradIOSH / CMIOSH, CSP, or recognized equivalent).
  • Collaboration & Influence: Proven ability to partner effectively across People/HR, Workplace/Real Estate, Physical Security/GSOC, Legal, and executive leadership.

Preferred:

  • Experience designing and scaling remote/hybrid ergonomic programs and digital ergonomics assessment platforms.
  • Experience integrating health and safety workflows with 24/7 Global Security Operations Centers (GSOC) and enterprise crisis management platforms.
  • Experience managing casualty insurance broker reviews and global risk management underwriting surveys.

 

Location & Working Arrangement

  • Primary Office: Dublin, Ireland.
  • Work Model: Hybrid (combining scheduled on-site collaboration at our Dublin office with remote flexibility, while accommodating global time zone collaboration across EMEA, AMER, and APAC).
  • Travel: Occasional international and regional travel (approx. 10–15%) to regional hubs, major global offices, and partner sites as operational needs dictate.

jobs.description_html:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

About Okta Secures AI Team

 The Okta for AI Agents Team is building the future of digital identity management. The way companies are using agents and allowing them access is undergoing a fundamental shift, enabling teams to move fast while staying secure. 

Our North Star is clear: To get AI right, you have to get identity right. We are not just managing identities; we are building the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. As organizations rapidly deploy AI, these non-human entities are acting with access to critical tools, often bypassing traditional perimeters and creating a 'Shadow AI' crisis. Our mission is to move identity from a reactive gatekeeper to a unified control plane, transforming AI risk into business ROI.

We are tackling this by implementing a comprehensive four-pillar maturity model: Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern. We are driving innovation by defining the standards for Agentic Identity—including pioneer work with securing AI Agents and support for protocols like MCP. You will be helping us build the infrastructure that allows enterprises to scale AI safely, ensuring every access decision—whether made by a human or an automated agent—is authenticated, authorized, and audited at scale.

We are a diverse team of engineers, product managers, and designers who are bringing Okta’s expertise in identity to define the future of Agent Identity management, focusing on enablement while staying secure.

About the role

In this role, you will join the Agent Access Policies sub-team under Okta Secures AI as a Principal Machine Learning (ML) Engineer to advance Okta's authorization capabilities. By replacing static, rule-based systems with dynamic AI security mechanisms, you will deliver real-time threat inspection, agent intent evaluation, and behavioral analysis—ensuring autonomous AI agents operate safely within specified bounds.

Your core mission will be architecting and driving features for our unified control plane to establish the premier Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. In doing so, you will help execute our guiding principle: "To get AI right, you have to get identity right."

What you’ll be doing 

  • Implement intent-based enforcement to verify agent runtime requests match their intended purpose, requiring key capabilities.
  • Apply LLM reasoning and prompt parsing to interpret prompts, tool payloads, and intent in real time.
  • Integrate low-latency inference or semantic evaluation engines directly into the API gateway request path.
  • Use embeddings, vector search, or zero-shot classification to score alignment between agent intent and executed actions.
  • Design confidence-scored decision engines that feed semantic verification results into policy frameworks (e.g., Cedar).
  • Establish evaluation benchmarks, prompt injection defenses, and guardrails to prevent bypasses or false positives.
  • Architect scalable ML and Generative AI systems integrating retrieval, inference, and evaluation pipelines.
  • Optimize prompting, context retrieval, and RAG workflows for accuracy, safety, and efficiency in Claude-based systems.
  • Build automated evaluation pipelines to measure model quality, correctness, groundedness, and safety in production.
  • Implement schema validation, structured output enforcement, and guardrails to ensure reliable, compliant AI outputs.
  • Mentor and coach engineers to support team and community growth.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 10+ years of software development experience, with strong programming expertise in Python (and familiarity with Go or Typescript a plus).
  • Hands-on experience with applied machine learning, from feature engineering to training and fine-tuning models.
  • Hands-on experience with modern Generative AI platforms (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).
  • Deep understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, and knowledge-base workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with LiteLLM, LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP, or other related AI agent frameworks.
  • Familiarity with ML frameworks (FastAPI, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark ML) and workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, etc.).
  • Experience defining evaluation metrics, pipelines, and feedback loops for ML/GenAI systems.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with product and engineering teams to drive greenfield initiatives forward, navigate unknowns, and iterate quickly and frequently.
  • Experience building tools or infrastructure for AI/ML applications, with a deep understanding of the developer lifecycle in an AI-native world.                                                                                                            

Extra credit

  • Experience integrating AI-driven systems with identity, authentication, or security products.
  • Exposure to ethical AI, model risk, or compliance frameworks.
  • Familiarity with evaluation datasets, synthetic data generation, or LLM-as-a-judge methods.

Education:Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field
